title: Explore Simpler Eigenmarking: Quantum Entailment Model Checking
summary: Targeting entailment model checking, a recent study has pioneered an idea of Eigenmarking search, an improvement over Grover search using extra qubits. The extra qubits condition the quantum state evolution such that the answer states (if exist) are always in the minority. The minority criteria is essential to Grover probability-amplitude amplification and consequently the effectiveness of Grover search.
